title: BenchX identity policy
description: A project's identity policy (docs/design/benchmark-result-schema.md section 4.3): for every reported fact, whether it must match, as is or normalized, for two results to share a series, or is ignored. It is the project's default projection, whose axis is always the subject revision, so only the roles are stored; other projections, such as the comparison profiles of section 5.5, reuse these roles with a different axis. Which estimators a project derives series for is separate configuration (section 4.5): the estimator enters series_fingerprint on its own, so adding one never changes the policy.
$comment: Rules the server enforces: paths are JSON Pointers into the reported coordinates (project, source, benchmark, coordinates); the longest matching path wins, so a role on a subtree can be overridden for one member; a null fact never equals anything; an ignored fact whose value differs from the previous point of a series is recorded as a warning on that point; any change other than description needs a new identity_schema.

identity_schema.description: Versioned name of the policy. Enters comparison_fingerprint, so series of different policies never mix.

default.description: Role of every reported fact not named in paths.

oneOf.description: match: equal values share a series. ignore: kept on the result and never splits a series; a change along a series is flagged on the point.
Match after normalizing: map replaces values by a table, keeping unlisted ones; canonical-uri normalizes a source URI.
